Here is a summary of our May 5, 2024 meeting:

- We discussed your requirements for the new project.

- We reviewed the initial design concepts and gathered your feedback.

Action items: Emma will update the project plan based on your feedback, and David will coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.

The next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

Best,
Emma Johnson
